VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The acceptance criteria require objective verification that "the duplicate-send bug is fixed and all 88 tests pass." The agent's self-report alone—without attached CI logs, test output, diffs, or independent artifacts—cannot satisfy this requirement. Self-reports are inherently unverifiable and do not constitute proof of test passage or bug resolution. Production-readiness claims require corroborating evidence (CI logs, signed test results, or witnessed verification).
